observable_failure_step.description: Execution trajectory evaluated as overall FAILURE due to triple defect cluster confirmed against physical deliverables and raw input baselines.

root_cause_diagnosis: The defect cluster (Font drift, inline English words, unfootnoted citations) occurred because: 1. Authoring scripts applied standard default plugin typography (B Nazanin) instead of referencing the project's institutional guidelines (B Lotus). 2. Scripts preserved literal inline English terms in parentheses instead of applying a transliteration and native Word footnote architecture. 3. Latin citations were left untouched or without footnotes. 4. The validator used a static dictionary mock that falsely reported 'PASS' instead of executing physical fail-closed DOM queries.
prescribed_behavior: 1. Authoring scripts must query and apply project-specific institutional typographical rules (e.g. from 01_raw_inputs/help.pdf) over generic plugin defaults. 2. All inline English terms must be transliterated into Persian, with original Latin terms placed in native Word footnotes (word/footnotes.xml). 3. The validation script must perform fail-closed physical DOM/XML inspection for w:rFonts, regex scans for inline Latin strings in Persian text, and cross-reference checks between text transliterations and footnotes without relying on static mock passes.
